scope: Fresh private production backup restored to new isolated resources; existing preview untouched
limits: Recovery covers WordPress files and SQL; compose/nginx/SSH/DNS/Origin/network-policy recovery and OOB are not certified.
Backup and raw restored data remain private. A fresh drift/backup gate is required at actual deployment time.

Initial extraction was stopped by exact owned-process digest after repeated gzip seeks proved unsuitable; no restore containers existed at that stop. The first partial copy and backup were retained privately.
The completed attempt used one-pass archive extraction, per-file content hash comparison, disk reserve guard, isolated database import, native WordPress boot and owned-resource cleanup.
No content release, live payment, credential rotation or shared-history rewrite occurred.
